digest.component_or_area: LLM gate usage recording and telemetry
propositions: Gate runs produce no durable record of model request counts or tool call counts despite computing them, preventing operators from tuning budgets or distinguishing loops from breadth
The loop-vs-breadth signal is computed by failure_usage() and discarded at the write boundary, violating the module's cited docstring contract
Gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG environment variable set record nothing at all, requiring live instrumented runs to answer single operational questions
The success path never calls the shape reducer, so successful runs record no tool call counts while failed runs do, creating asymmetric observability
Operators cannot determine whether high recursion-limit usage represents a loop (repeated tool calls) or genuine breadth (distinct signatures) without re-running instrumented gates
